protect.en: So, Neil, itching is our skin's way of protecting itself against harmful parasites.
protect.zh: So, Neil, itching is our skin's way of protecting itself against harmful parasites.

probably.en: Probably not. So if you are visiting Britain, what should you actually eat?
probably.zh: 可能不会。所以如果你正在访问英国，你实际上应该吃什么？

probably.en: And probably it's quite a good thing to experience rejection, even if it doesn't feel nice.
probably.zh: 而且，即便体验拒绝的感觉并不好受，但这可能也是件挺好的事。

probably.en: Probably Britain’s most internationally famous dish.
probably.zh: 这可能是英国国际上最著名的菜肴。

probably.en: Anyone who grew up watching The Simpsons probably remembers Homer walking into his job at a nuclear power plant, and there being big drums of fluorescent green slime that gives fish three eyes.
probably.zh: 看《辛普森一家》长大的人可能都记得荷马在核电站上班的情景，里面有大桶荧光绿色的黏液，能让鱼长出三只眼睛。

pretty.en: Well, it seems like people were pretty nice to Hannah in those examples.
pretty.zh: 嗯，看来在这些例子里，大家对 Hannah 还挺友善的。

proper.en: Now, this social media trend is called rejection therapy, but it's not a proper form of therapy.
proper.zh: 虽然这种社交媒体潮流被称为“拒绝疗法”，但它并不是一种正式的治疗手段。

protest.en: Today, that number is zero. And many countries, especially in Europe, have gone a similar route: initial excitement in the post-war period about this "new" and revolutionary technology, and then a turn towards protest and opposition.
protest.zh: 如今，这一数字为零。许多国家，尤其是欧洲国家，都走过了一条相似的道路：战后初期对这项“全新”且具有革命性的技术充满热情，随后转向抗议和反对。

process.en: A data centre is a huge building full of computer servers, the machines that store and process information for the internet.
process.zh: 数据中心是一座巨大的建筑，里面装满了计算机服务器，也就是为互联网存储和处理信息的机器。

process.en: The post-war decades saw the growth of processed food and convenience food: frozen vegetables, canned food, instant meals, microwave meals.
process.zh: 战后几十年见证了加工食品和便利食品的增长：冷冻蔬菜、罐头食品、即食餐、微波炉食品。

process.en: A person living in an industrial city would be eating food that had traveled hundreds of kilometers and had been processed by people they never met.
process.zh: 一个生活在工业城市的人，吃的食物可能已经旅行了数百公里，并由他们从未见过的人加工过。

process.en: Plants had been scheduled for closure. Engineers had already begun the paperwork for decommissioning , which is the long, careful process of shutting a reactor down for good and making it safe.
process.zh: 各核电站已被安排关闭。工程师们已经开始为退役办理手续，退役是一个漫长而谨慎的过程，旨在彻底关闭反应堆并确保其安全。

prepare.en: British chefs have taken traditional foods and prepare them in new ways.
prepare.zh: 英国厨师采用了传统食物并以新的方式烹制它们。

prepare.en: Working-class families now had less time to prepare food.
prepare.zh: 工人阶级家庭现在有更少的时间准备食物。

prepare.en: It announced it wanted to extend the lifespans of the ones that had already been prepared for shutdown, and it started looking at building new ones.
prepare.zh: 它还宣布希望延长那些已经准备关闭的反应堆的寿命，并开始考虑建造新的反应堆。

produce.en: And after it's up and running , nuclear power produces almost no carbon emissions .
produce.zh: 而且一旦投入运行，核电几乎不产生碳排放。

produce.en: Some foods were completely unavailable. This produced a very unusual food culture.
produce.zh: 有些食物完全买不到。这产生了一种非常不寻常的饮食文化。

produce.en: This is what people started to eat. The Industrial Revolution also changed the way food was produced.
produce.zh: 这就是人们开始吃的东西。工业革命也改变了食物的生产方式。

produce.en: In other words, it effectively gets its own nuclear reactor , and all of the energy it produces is earmarked for data centres.
produce.zh: 换句话说，它实际上拥有了自己的核反应堆，而且其生产的所有能源都专门用于数据中心。

provide.en: They needed food that would provide them with enough energy to get through a difficult working day.
provide.zh: 他们需要能够为他们提供足够能量以度过艰难工作日的食物。

provide.en: Now it's Microsoft, Meta, Amazon, and Google that are bankrolling reactors , providing the money that governments once did.
provide.zh: 现在，资助反应堆的是微软、Meta、亚马逊和谷歌，它们提供了曾经由政府提供的资金。

provide.en: If banks and investors provide you with €1 billion in financing at a 10% interest rate , let's say, that's €100 million in interest payments every year.
provide.zh: 比方说，如果银行和投资者为你提供10亿欧元的融资，利率为10%，那么每年光是利息支出就有1亿欧元。

project.en: Anyway, its initial projected cost was £18 billion, and it was expected to come online in 2025.
project.zh: 不管怎样，其最初预计成本为180亿英镑，原计划于2025年并网发电。

project.en: As of today, mid-2026, its projected cost is £48 billion in inflation-adjusted terms, and it's not scheduled to come online before 2030.
project.zh: 截至今天，即2026年年中，经通胀调整后其预计成本已达480亿英镑，且预计要到2030年之后才能并网。

promise.en: The promise is alluring : cheap, clean, abundant electricity for everyone.
promise.zh: 这一愿景极具诱惑力：为每个人提供廉价、清洁、充沛的电力。

promise.en: Nuclear power has a long history of projects that were promised on time and on budget, and then arrived years late and billions over.
promise.zh: 在核电领域，承诺按时完工、不超预算，最终却拖延数年并超支数十亿美元的项目屡见不鲜。

product.en: But the alternative is running out of power to sell their own products.
product.zh: 但不这样做的后果，就是没有足够的电力来销售他们自己的产品。

product.en: People would also potentially have dairy products from cows and sheep, and perhaps keep chickens or other animals.
product.zh: 人们还可能拥有来自牛和羊的乳制品，也许还养鸡或其他动物。

product.en: Its exact origins are disputed , but it’s generally understood to be a product of the British Indian restaurant tradition.
product.zh: 它的具体起源备受争议，但人们普遍理解它是英国印度餐馆传统的产物。

product.en: It's a lot when you think that it's like the electricity used by 18 million people, but if you think that this is powering products used by a large proportion of the world's population, perhaps it seems more reasonable.
product.zh: 如果你想到这相当于1800万人的用电量，那确实很多；但如果你想到这为全球很大一部分人口所使用的产品提供了动力，也许就显得更合理了。

proportion.en: It's a lot when you think that it's like the electricity used by 18 million people, but if you think that this is powering products used by a large proportion of the world's population, perhaps it seems more reasonable.
proportion.zh: 如果你想到这相当于1800万人的用电量，那确实很多；但如果你想到这为全球很大一部分人口所使用的产品提供了动力，也许就显得更合理了。

private.en: In any case, never before has so much private money been committed to nuclear energy, and we are only six years into the decade.
private.zh: 无论如何，历史上从未有如此多的私人资金投入到核能领域，而这个十年才刚刚过去六年。

private.en: For decades, nuclear power depended almost entirely on governments: government funding, government regulation, government risk-taking, because private investors found it too expensive and too slow.
private.zh: 几十年来，核电几乎完全依赖政府：政府出资、政府监管、政府承担风险，因为私人投资者觉得它太昂贵、见效太慢。

prototype.en: At least, that's the idea. This is still new technology, largely a technology of blueprints and prototypes rather than working power stations.
prototype.zh: 至少，理论上是这样的。这仍是一项新技术，在很大程度上还停留在图纸和原型阶段，而非投入实用的发电站。

press.en: Sceptics point out that SMRs are, so far, mostly a story told in press releases and government funding announcements, not in electricity actually flowing onto the grid .
press.zh: 怀疑论者指出，到目前为止，SMR 主要还只是新闻稿和政府拨款公告里的故事，并没有真正向电网输送电力。

progress.en: But there has been significant investment and progress in solving this issue.
progress.zh: 但在解决这一问题上，已经有了大量投资和长足进展。

properly.en: And regulators in the US have started treating fusion as a properly separate category from traditional nuclear power, with lighter rules, because a fusion reactor can't melt down the way a fission reactor can.
properly.zh: 美国的监管机构也已开始将核聚变视为与传统核电完全不同的独立类别，适用的法规更为宽松，因为聚变反应堆不会像裂变反应堆那样发生堆芯熔毁。

preserve.en: Peasants across Europe ate simple food based on what they could grow, raise, preserve, catch.
preserve.zh: 全欧洲的农民都吃简单的食物，这些食物基于他们能够种植、饲养、保存和捕获的东西。

prefer.en: But the food of ordinary people continued to be based on local ingredients and traditional recipes By the 18th century, some British writers were already complaining about this trend, criticizing wealthy British people who preferred French cooks to English ones.
prefer.zh: 但普通人的食物继续以本地食材和传统食谱为基础。到了18世纪，一些英国作家已经开始抱怨这种趋势，批评那些宁愿要法国厨师也不要英国厨师的富有英国人。

previously.en: The land that had been previously available for people to grow their food now became privately controlled.
previously.zh: 以前可供人们种植食物的土地现在变成了私有控制。

production.en: Britain became the pioneer of mass production, and this was applied to food as well.
production.zh: 英国成为了大规模生产的先驱，这也应用到了食物上。

priority.en: And because working-class people had limited incomes, the quality of the food was not the priority.
priority.zh: 而且由于工人阶级收入有限，食物的质量不是优先考虑的。

priority.en: And when the country is at war, making nice food is not really the priority of most people.
priority.zh: 当国家处于战争状态时，做出好吃的食物并不是大多数人的首要任务。
